name: motion-pack
description: A deterministic motion-production pack for AI agents: transitions, cuts, synthesised SFX and music, finishing layers, kinetic type, camera moves, 3D objects, Blender plates, baked physics and genre templates for HyperFrames, three.js and Blender, a playbook of formats and ten named visual styles, plus six skills that plan, design, build, test and ship the video. Works from any folder: the skill finds the pack (MOTION_PACK_HOME, ~/.motion-pack/<version>) or fetches the checksum-verified release with mp init.
